PORT AUTHORITIES ACT 1963

PORT KELANG AUTHORITY (SCALE OF RATES, DUES AND CHARGES)
(AMENDMENT) BY-LAWS 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by sections 16 a nd 29  of the
Port Authorities Act 1963 [ Act 488 ], the Port Kelang Authority,
with the approval of the Minister, makes the following by-laws:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These by-laws may be cited as the Port Kelang Authority (Scale of Rates,
Dues and Charges) (Amendment) By-Laws 2023.

 (2)     These By-laws come into operation on 15 September 2023.

Amendment of by-law 2
2. The Port Kelang Authority (Scale of Rates, Dues and Charges) By -laws 2012
[P.U. (A) 125/2012 ], which are referred to as the "princi pal By-laws" in these By -laws,
are amended by inserting after the definition of "cargo" the following definition:

‘  "conventional cargo" means cargo other than containerized cargo; '.

Amendment of by-law 4
3. By-law 4 of the principal By-laws is amended by substituting for paragraph 4(1)
the following paragraph:

 "(1) A port user, in relation to a ship entering the Port, shall pay the port
dues to the Authority as follows:

(a) in the case of a ship—

(i) loading or discharging cargoes; or

(ii) embarking or disembarking passengers,

 at the rate specified in Table A of Part 1 of the First Schedule;

(b) in the case of a ship which call at  the Port for bunkering,
taking water, ship's supplies or repair, at the rate as specified
in Table B of Part 1 of the First Schedule; and

(c) in the case of a ship calling the Port for pu rposes other than
stated in sub paragraph (a) or (b), at the rate as specified
in Table C of Part 1 of the First Schedule.".
